title: Agriculture in Greece, 20th century
descriptions: This data set presents statistical data on various kinds of agricultural production and distribution, and the distribution of cattle in Greece. Some files concern a specific agricultural product or a part of the cattle production (sheep, horses etc.). In each file, the data are divided according to regions and departments of Greece and according to the type of product. Crop areas are available for the years 1963, 1969, 1973, 1978 and 1984. The data set contains one file with statistical data on the (number of) establishment(s) of industries and the (annual) employment.
